description: This file implements a multi-threaded proxy resolver for network requests, including classes for managing worker threads, jobs, and the resolver factory, with detailed handling of proxy resolution requests in a multi-threaded environment.

classes.name: Executor
classes.description: Manages a worker thread and a synchronous proxy resolver to handle proxy resolution jobs asynchronously.

classes.name: MultiThreadedProxyResolver
classes.description: Implements a multi-threaded proxy resolver that distributes proxy resolution requests across multiple worker threads.

classes.name: Job
classes.description: Base class for jobs executed by the proxy resolver, including specific jobs for creating resolvers and querying proxies.

classes.name: MultiThreadedProxyResolver::RequestImpl
classes.description: Wraps a proxy resolution job request for external use.

classes.name: CreateResolverJob
classes.description: Job that runs on a worker thread to create a proxy resolver.

classes.name: MultiThreadedProxyResolver::GetProxyForURLJob
classes.description: Job that runs on a worker thread to resolve proxy for a given URL.

methods.name: Executor::StartJob
methods.description: Starts a job on the executor's thread.

methods.name: Executor::Destroy
methods.description: Cleans up the executor, cancels jobs, and joins the thread.

methods.name: MultiThreadedProxyResolver::GetProxyForURL
methods.description: Initiates a proxy resolution request, distributing it to an idle worker or queuing it.

methods.name: MultiThreadedProxyResolver::AddNewExecutor
methods.description: Creates and starts a new worker thread for proxy resolution.
